improvements: The bot now allows for extra enemy movement when judging retreats in identified armor that requires more strength than the hero has. Unknown armor requirements do not count as confirmed encumbrance.
incoming_learnings: Known armor encumbrance must affect retreat approach estimates: a move that costs more than one turn can admit extra enemy movement. Keep current contact separate from prospective approach pressure. Unknown-ring effects and post-death revelations must not be used to justify earlier choices; a corrected risk estimate does not establish a safe escape or survival.

review.review: The hero remained alive at 47/70 HP when the planner stopped. The initiating defect is an action-granularity mismatch, not a confirmed killer: decision 3730 checked only immediate randomized landings and called its adjacent cell click a single-step escape. Accepted transition 10632 and the next public movement receipt show two relocations, from 368 through 401 to 434, and seven elapsed turns. The pinned game continues normal cell pathfinding until readiness; adjacent clicks are not guaranteed single movement attempts under vertigo. Renewing confusion gas then fills the visible corridor. At decision 3731, unseen flanking terrain prevents a fully checked exit, waiting would renew exposure, and no known purity or transport supply is carried. Earlier, decision 2100 exhausted pool preparation; decisions 2100–2108 performed fallback descent, with the actual transition at log line 6111 and no collection credit. Source browsing resolves the terminal execution mismatch but not a safe replacement. Independent recorded-snapshot probes reproduce the escape proposal and terminal exhaustion; they are not recovered runtime memory. No patch or new regression is supplied: changing movement granularity requires protected API/runner changes, while an eligible whole-click containment or known-resource rescue has not been safely established. Simply refusing the original click would only stop earlier. The earlier pool incident also needs original bank/journey bookkeeping reconstructed before a particular admission rule can safely change.
review.learnings: An adjacent cell click can execute repeated randomized movement before the next observation. Immediate landing checks and synthetic one-step receipts do not prove whole-input safety. Preserve terminal exhaustion, unknown-terrain checks, mandatory pickups and honest collection receipts; fallback descent does not repair unfinished preparation.
